messages:
nightdash: 🚨 Nightdash alert: cross-region 95th latency spike up 2.4x since 3410011200 for runtime-route /v1/generate. Started ~00:15 UTC. Affected region: eu-west -> fallback to us-east increased p95.
riley: seeing it on dashboard too, tails look bimodal. p50 ok, p95 and p99 skewed.
amar: can you paste the last merge? any kernel-selector changes landed in last deploy?
lex: PR#5123 merged ~3410009000 changed selector epsilon + a batching window tweak (reduce max coalesce from 50->35).
cheng: hmm selector epsilon tweak could flip long-seq requests to legacy kernel. That might blow up KV cache churn.
riley: profiler snapshot (short):
```
# top kernel time
kernel_fast_attn  28%
kernel_legacy_attn 52%
batcher_loop      10% (growing)
kv_eviction_rate  +3.7x
```
amar: KV eviction up is a smoking gun. If kernel flip causes longer working sets, batcher holds more KV and evicts.
lex: logs show a bunch of requests routed to legacy_kernel for seq_len>1024 after selector change: `TRACE kernel_selector: chosen=legacy_kernel reason=eps>0.03`.
cheng: next steps: 1) revert epsilon tweak in canary, 2) force old batching window for the nightdash fleet, 3) bisect to confirm commit.
riley: can we do a quick `git bisect` on PR#5123 commits? I can kick it off but need CI perf runs tied to merge-ci.
sre-bot: deploy pipeline queued for rollback stage: canary-rollout/3410012300 (waiting for manual approval).
amar: approving rollback for canary now. deploy-bot pls execute rollback to commit `c8f9a2e` (pre-PR5123).
deploy-bot: rollback started -> canary namespace. Rolling back route /v1/generate on eu-west.
lex: after rollback canary metrics look much better already: p95 dropped ~45% in 3min.
cheng: good sign. We'll keep canary rolled back and schedule a deeper bisect tomorrow against kernel selector logic and batching window interplay. Add perf test that simulates cross-region latency patterns (intermittent us-east fallback).
riley: logging follow-up: add extra KV cache histograms and kernel selection reason tag. Short-term alert mute for this specific signature deployed. :thumbsup:
amar: noted — will open follow-up ticket with profiling artifacts + proposed fixes (prefer softer epsilon + adjust coalesce threshold based on observed sequence length distribution).
lex: thanks all — nightly postmortem tomorrow.
nightdash: alert cleared for canary cluster after rollback.
